name: rocalytics
description: Add @rocapine/rocalytics-sdk to an Expo app and wire it end to end: the Rocalytics client (install, identify, purchases from Superwall, RevenueCat or native paywalls), onboarding run tracking, paywall presentation tracking and product analytics through @rocapine/react-native-onboarding. Also sets up Adjust (react-native-adjust): tokens from the publishing platform, attribution into Rocalytics, user_converted with Meta dedup ids and store subscription tracking. Ships facebook-superwall (Facebook SDK purchases from Superwall events).
